## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `28502c678479e95831baee8ed47693fbccd398af`
Local-runs: probe — `ui` `node scripts/check-bash32-floor.mjs --self-test` (160 cases, exit 0) and the run (5 tracked shell files, exit 0) on a detached worktree of the head, to confirm the population root `.claude/hooks/**` going empty leaves the gate green; the worktree was removed afterwards. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test` was attempted on the same worktree and exited 3 before measuring anything (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no `node_modules` in this checkout), so it is not a local measurement; the CI job `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, which runs `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges`, is green on this head.
Scope: ui/.claude/settings.json, ui/.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout.sh, ui/.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout-bash.sh, ui/.claude/hooks/guard-shared-stash.sh, ui/.claude/hooks/guard-tree-enum.sh, ui/.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout.selftest.sh, ui/.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout-bash.selftest.sh, ui/.claude/hooks/guard-shared-stash.selftest.sh, ui/.claude/hooks/guard-tree-enum.selftest.sh + scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs (the `ui-claude-tree` specimen at :4519 and the assertions at :4523, :4525, :4530–:4532 that read `UI_SPECIMENS`), .claude/settings.json (root hook wiring, read), .claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout.sh, .claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout-bash.sh, .claude/hooks/guard-shared-stash.sh, .claude/hooks/guard-tree-enum.sh and their four `.selftest.sh` (root counterparts, read), .github/workflows/lint.yml:1874 (hook self-test discovery, read), ui/scripts/check-bash32-floor.mjs:242 (population root, read), ui/.claude/skills/verify/SKILL.md (the new specimen, read)

### ① Derived judgments

Diff on `origin/main...28502c678`: +1/−2846 over 10 files, one commit. Governed paths: 9 of 10 under `ui/.claude/**` (register row `ui-claude-tree`, Tier H, CODEOWNERS `/ui/.claude/ @os-zhuang @hotlong`); the tenth is `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`, the register's own self-test. Mixed diff, one hit is enough: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

1. Deleted `ui/.claude/hooks/*`, 8 files. Correct: `git ls-tree` of the head shows `ui/.claude/` holding only `launch.json`, `settings.json`, `skills/objectui-contributor/**` (4 files) and `skills/verify/SKILL.md`. The deletion changes no published package surface and no runtime; the files were PreToolUse hooks that only a session rooted at `ui/` would load, and after the merge no session is.
2. Per-hook coverage, verified by diffing each ui file (base) against its root counterpart (head) with comment and blank lines stripped:
   - `guard-main-checkout.sh` and its selftest: byte-identical logic (diff empty). Root wiring: `.claude/settings.json` PreToolUse matcher `Edit|Write|NotebookEdit`, the same event the ui settings used.
   - `guard-main-checkout-bash.sh`: the only difference is three lines of the refusal message (issue ref `objectui#3435` vs `#5790`, re-wrapped). Selftest: expectations differ only in repo-specific example strings (`@object-ui/app-shell` vs `@objectstack/spec`, issue refs, one non-ASCII glyph case). Root wiring: PreToolUse `Bash`.
   - `guard-shared-stash.sh`: logic identical; the root refusal text is a superset (adds the commit-first reverse-verification recipe and the Prime Directive #11 cite). Selftest: root has the same cases plus two extra `expect block` cases (#11738), i.e. the root self-test is stricter, not looser. Root wiring: PreToolUse `Bash`.
   - `guard-tree-enum.sh`: one message line differs (`Measured HERE` vs `Measured on objectui`). Selftest: repo-specific example strings only. Root wiring: PreToolUse `Bash`.
   Root `.claude/settings.json` wires all four on the same tool events the ui settings did (and adds `guard-process-kill.sh` and a `SessionStart` hook that ui never had). The root `guard-main-checkout.sh` verdict is keyed on the git common dir of the edited file's directory, not on a path subset, so a write under `ui/**` on the shared checkout is blocked exactly as one under `packages/**`. No ui guard protection is lost in the merged repo. The PR body's per-hook table states the same four verdicts and I found them accurate.
3. `ui/.claude/settings.json`: only the `hooks` block (old L37–61) is removed; the `permissions.allow` (12 rows) and `permissions.deny` (17 rows) blocks are untouched, and the head file parses (`JSON.parse` succeeds). `ui/.claude/launch.json` and `ui/.claude/skills/**` have an empty `git diff --stat` against `origin/main`.
4. `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`: a one-token change at :4519, `'ui-claude-tree': 'ui/.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout.sh'` becomes `'ui/.claude/skills/verify/SKILL.md'`. The register row (:1209, `prefix: 'ui/.claude/'`, Tier H) and the matcher (`governedPathsIn` :1508, `p.startsWith(surface.prefix)`) are unchanged, so the new path is governed by `ui-claude-tree` alone (the root `claude-tree` row's prefix `.claude/` does not match it, and no `skills/`-prefixed row does either). The row assertions at :4523 (`the-ui-claude-tree-specimen-is-governed-by-its-own-row-alone`), :4525 (`every-ui-row-lands-Tier-H-the-ui-claude-tree-included`, including the mixed-diff pair with `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`), :4530, :4531 and :4532 all read `UI_SPECIMENS` and keep exercising the row with a path that exists on the head tree. The thread reports 537 assertions before and after; CI `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (which runs this self-test) is green on the head.
5. Remaining readers of the deleted paths on the head tree: `git grep` for `ui/.claude/hooks` returns nothing; `git grep` for the four guard names outside `.claude/hooks/` returns only the root wiring (`.claude/settings.json:106–127`), root-hook prose (AGENTS.md:236–337, `docs/audits/gate-census-2026-09.md`, `lint.yml:1816`, `dispatch-gates.mjs:642`), root self-test fixtures in `check-governed-merges.mjs` (:4453, :4572, :4612) and `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs:4646`, console CHANGELOG history, and the synthetic ui strings the thread listed (`ui/scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs:1326`, `dependabot-merge-gate.mjs:232`, `__tests__/bash32-floor-wiring.test.ts:126`, `check-shell-escape-residue.test.ts:271–547`). No test, workflow, CODEOWNERS row, or doc references the deleted files. `ui/.github/workflows/**` has no `.claude/hooks` or selftest mention. `lint.yml:1874` discovers self-tests with `find .claude/hooks` from the root only, so CI never ran the ui copies and loses nothing.
6. `ui/scripts/check-bash32-floor.mjs:242` keeps `.claude/hooks/**` as a population root; on the head its tracked population is 5 shell files (`e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`, `stop-backend.sh`, `scripts/ci-setup-pnpm.sh`, `ensure-chromium-ready.sh`, `setup.sh`), down from 13, and the gate exits 0 with its self-test (160 cases) green. The gate only fails on an empty total population, so the empty root is harmless.

### ② Semver level

No published package changes; `skip-changeset` label present and `Check Changeset` is green. Clause-② no, Metadata-protocol none, both declared on the PR body and consistent with the diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

- PR body carries `Fixes #27260`, `Part of #26080`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, the per-hook coverage table and the 维护者速读 block; the PR is draft with `size/xl` and `skip-changeset`. The commit message names the card's three moves and carries the `Claude-Session` trailer; the thread reports `check-commit-card-trailers` green.
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no other login to name.
- The card's text said this PR is Tier S (`.claude/**`); the register row `ui-claude-tree` is Tier H and the PR body, claim 6514396208 and the queue guard all treat it as Tier H. The PR is right; the card's wording is stale and no action is owed here.
- Triage 6513069907 requirement (specimen moves to a surviving or synthetic `ui/.claude/**` path): met, see ① item 4. The new specimen `ui/.claude/skills/verify/SKILL.md` is a tracked file last touched by #27018; no open card proposes deleting or moving `ui/.claude/skills/**` (search over the repo's issues returned only #27260 and #26080, and #25832 moved `ui/skills/objectui`, a different tree, already merged). It is as stable as any other path under the row; should it ever go, the self-test fails loudly at :4523 rather than silently.
- `deviations: []` in the thread report; `open_questions` none. The report's gate list (36 derived, 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED) is consistent with the check-runs.
- CI state at review time (check-runs API, head `28502c678`): no failed run. Green: Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Auto Label, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · scoped (3), Type Check (5), Test UI (16/16 + aggregate), Live E2E UI, Build UI Deps, Dogfood Regression Gate, Plan Test Core shards, Test Core (2/8). Still in progress: Test Core (1/8), Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Lint · PM dispatch-gates. Skipped by path filter: Build Core, Build Docs, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood Verify CLI, UI Published Artifacts, opt-in harnesses. The landing-time check for all-green remains with the dispatch seat.

### ④ Design judgment

`hits`: `ui/.claude/settings.json`, the 8 `ui/.claude/hooks/*` files.

- The deletion holds against the scenario the card accepts it on: Claude Code resolves hooks from `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.json`, and the merged repository's project root is the repository root, so the nested `ui/.claude/settings.json` hook rows were never read and the eight scripts never executed. Removing them takes away no enforcement (② above shows the root copies are the same logic on the same events, in one case stricter) and removes a governed surface that misled readers into believing a second guard set was live, which is exactly the card's business reason.
- Keeping the `permissions` block of `ui/.claude/settings.json` is the right scope: the card names only the hook rows; whether the nested permissions block is itself dead is #26080's remaining question, not this card's.
- The specimen edit in `check-governed-merges.mjs` is the rule and its gate read as one change: the row text is untouched, only the self-test's probe path moves to a file that exists, keeping `ui-claude-tree` under Tier H assertions. A synthetic path would also have satisfied triage; a real surviving file is the better choice because `ids()` is path-string based and a real file also keeps the Tier H human-approval scenario (`governedTierFor` with a root `.claude/agents` path mixed in) tied to something a PR can actually touch.
- Nothing here changes the governed register, AGENTS.md or any published skill; no ADR is cited or owed.

- 风险与回滚：没有丢失任何保护：逐个 hook 比对过，只有提示文案不同；根的 main-checkout 按 git common dir 判定，覆盖 `ui/**`。治理自测仍覆盖 `ui-claude-tree` 这一行（Tier H）。revert 即回滚。
- 先看：PR 正文的逐 hook 覆盖表，再看 `check-governed-merges.mjs` 里 `UI_SPECIMENS` 那一行。

- **形态:** one PR, `Fixes #27260`, `Part of #26080`, ten files (+1/−2846): the 8 deleted hooks, `ui/.claude/settings.json` (hooks block only), `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` (one specimen). `skip-changeset`. Governed `ui/.claude/**`: `check-governed-merges.mjs` reads Tier H (`ui-claude-tree`); 2847 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold.
- **前提实测:** per hook, the root guard's verdict logic matches the ui copy (main-checkout byte-identical; the other three differ only in message lines), and root `.claude/settings.json` wires all four on the same events (review ①). Locally 36 derived gates green; governed-merges self-test 537 before and after.

- **范围外去向:** review should-fix 1, the empty `.claude/hooks/**` population root in `ui/scripts/check-bash32-floor.mjs:242`, is noted and not filed: the gate still has a non-empty population (5 tracked shell files) and tolerates an empty root. The next devx `ui/scripts` change picks it up.
